newsitem.title: CANADA: Concorde lands in Halifax after engine trouble.
newsitem.headline: Concorde lands in Halifax after engine trouble.

text.p: A British Airways Concorde jet en route to New York made an emergency landing in Halifax, Nova Scotia on Friday after it developed engine trouble over the Atlantic, airport officials said.
The plane landed safely shortly before 10 A.M. EST (1500 GMT) on three of its four engines.
"We didn't have emergency crews out there. No assistance was required," the Halifax airport duty manager told Reuters.
The Concorde was traveling to New York's John F Kennedy airport from London. No information was immediately available about how many passengers were on the supersonic jet.
